 Light snowfall likely in Koshi, Gandaki highlands; Fog forecast in Tarai
 THT Online
 By THT Online 
 Published: 09:36 am Nov 18, 2026 
 File - A view of Nyatapola (the five-storeyed temple) in Bhaktapur and its surroundings, as seen from Suryabinayak Municipality–Sipadol, after the rain stopped and the weather cleared with sunshine on Saturday. Photo: Renu Twanabasu / RSS 
 Key Takeaways: Light rain or snowfall possible in the Himalayan regions of Koshi and Gandaki
 Partly cloudy conditions forecast in several hill and mountain provinces
 Morning fog and mist likely in parts of the Tarai, valleys and river basins
 Kathmandu temperatures expected between 20–22°C during the day
 Jumla forecast to record the lowest overnight temperatures
 KATHMANDU, NOVEMBER 18 
 Light rain or snowfall is likely at isolated locations in the Himalayan regions of Koshi and Gandaki provinces on Wednesday, while fog and mist are expected to affect parts of the Tarai during the early morning, according to the Department of Hydrology and Meteorology.

 Hills and mountains may see rain, snow; fog forecast in Tarai 
 The department has forecast partly cloudy conditions in the Himalayan and hilly regions of Koshi, Bagmati, Gandaki and Lumbini provinces. Most other parts of the country are expected to experience mainly fair weather.
 Similar conditions are expected to continue into the night, with partly cloudy skies forecast in the hill and mountain regions of Koshi, Bagmati and Gandaki provinces.
 -->
 -->
 Meteorologists have also warned of mist and fog in some areas of the Tarai, valleys and river basins, which could reduce visibility during the morning hours.
 The current weather pattern is being influenced by the partial effect of westerly winds, the department said.
 Kathmandu is expected to record temperatures between 20°C and 22°C during the day and 8°C to 10°C at night. Janakpur and Bhairahawa are forecast to be among the warmest locations, with maximum temperatures reaching 27°C to 29°C, while Jumla is expected to remain the coldest, with minimum temperatures ranging from -2°C to 0°C.
